title: Pixel 11 pops up in early leaks and it's a familiar cyclops look for Google's next - Digital Trends
summary: Google's Pixel 11 series is set to release with a sleek design featuring slim bezels and a 6.3-inch OLED screen with a 120Hz refresh rate. The new models will use Google's in-house Tensor silicon and may offer more storage options. However, details about the camera hardware remain unclear.
sentiment_reason: The Pixel 11 series is receiving positive sentiment due to the anticipated design improvements and potential increase in storage capacity, although the lack of camera details could be a concern for some buyers.
